scope: Exact article, topical pharmacology, material/model routes, current programs, selected public rights and staged product proof

recommendation.scientific: Advance finite controlled clinical proof with a standardized marketed 1.5% cream after protocol/article/measurement qualification
recommendation.standalone_asset: Not established; require differentiated benefit and executable manufacturing, regulatory and rights route

article.historical_case_identity_limit: Active/concentration/route verified; not all brands, vehicles or lots authenticated

PK_anchor.indication: AD; no HHD-specific quantitative PK verified
PK_anchor.reference_281_nM: Whole-blood TPO-pSTAT3 JAK2/myelosuppression proxy, not universal safety or HHD efficacy threshold
PK_anchor.binding: 97% plasma binding does not permit a validated margin against a whole-blood assay
PK_anchor.study_counting_rule: Age/BSA subgroups and repeated visits overlap; no inferred new patients

HHD_exposure_questions: Active erosion, maceration and fold location
Systemic exposure early and after healing
No imported AD threshold, washout or accumulation rule

control_routes.estimand: Contribution of active within specified vehicle
control_routes.qualification: Quantitative composition, pH, rheology, barrier effects, stability and masking

control_routes.route: Marketed cream plus standardized care vs same care, randomized with masked outcome assessment
control_routes.limitation: Participant expectation and vehicle effects not isolated

models.name: Gupta ATP2C1 mono/biallelic knockout keratinocytes
models.readiness: Published research route; exact parent identity must be authenticated
models.lineage: 2025 preprint and 2026 final are one project
models.scope: Acute spreading/regrowth; not qualified delayed mature-barrier repair
models.final_access: Indexed primary sections plus full earlier preprint
models.CDN1163_limit: Final indexed results report little restoration of junctional morphology; not full barrier-positive control

models.name: ATCC CRL-4048 Ker-CT
models.readiness: Catalog parent/alternate engineering route; not exact published N/TERT line or ready HHD model

models.name: Ayers MEK/ROCK organotypic preprint
models.readiness: Abstract-only model/comparator lead; no audited full methods/denominator or rux efficacy

KB111.article: Topical HSV-1 ATP2C1 gene vector; different article

competition.Incyte_HS: Phase III ruxolitinib cream in a different disease; Q4 2026 topline anticipated, not HHD efficacy

rights.selected_claim_family: US10758543B2 composition claims not confined to AD
rights.litigation: Pending per sponsor; formulation/use claims extending 2031/2040, composition coverage incl pediatric extension to Dec2028 reported unchallenged by those notices

regulatory.marketed_drug_IND_exemption: Cannot assume when intended to support a new indication/label change; all criteria must apply
regulatory.505b2: Potential strategy, not patent clearance or an agreed application
regulatory.three_year_exclusivity: Conditional and scope-limited; March2026 Q&A is draft; not automatic control of off-label prescribing

development_proof.Stage_A: Article/control, baseline and endpoint reliability, exposure/safety methods, protocol/regulatory scope and specific product contribution
development_proof.Stage_B: Randomized patient-level comparison, one preselected clinical estimand, masked outcome assessment, exposure linked to active/healed lesions
development_proof.Stage_C: Independent confirmation and measured product advantage
development_proof.optional_model: Only for discriminating article/population/mechanism/exposure questions; no immune-free negative veto
development_proof.planning_window: 8–12-week controlled observation is an initial planning assumption, not a validated standard
development_proof.advance: Useful controlled benefit or comparable efficacy with meaningful burden/tolerability advantage and interpretable exposure
development_proof.stop_or_redirect: Clinically unhelpful result despite adequate delivery, unacceptable effective-exposure harm, or no credible product contribution for standalone asset objective
